reason: The intent asks to hard-exclude videos where someone is eating. Only item 61004 has direct evidence of a person eating: its caption says a mechanic cleans a bicycle chain between bites of a sandwich. Taking bites of a sandwich is eating, even though the item is a repair video and has no food category. The cooking items (61001, 61002, 61009) show recipes, dinner, salad and bread, but preparing food does not establish that anyone eats on screen, so that relationship is too weak. Item 61003 is tagged street food and night market, but its caption only describes a walk between stalls, with no evidence that someone eats. Items 61005 to 61008 have no relation to eating, and 61010 has no usable evidence. The request contains no negation to resolve. Operation exclude and strength none are kept unchanged; strength none means hard exclusion of the selected item. This is a review proposal and does not execute the control.
